wins: Consistently achieved a reward of 60 despite repeated mentor interventions, showing stable policy execution under guidance.
Engaged proactively with 10 mentor calls, ensuring continued feedback loops for future improvement.
fails: 0% success rate: the agent failed to complete the primary objective despite completing a single episode.

key_outcomes.summary: The run demonstrated consistent reward accumulation but lacked objective completion and autonomy; focus should be on translating mentor guidance into independent actions.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Agent consistently failed to translate reconnaissance into follow-on exploitation, stopping after enumeration without pivoting to the target service.

skill_cards.if_condition: When port 22 is open and SSH banner detected
skill_cards.then_action: Run SSH enumeration with targeted nmap scripts to gather service details

skill_cards.if_condition: When HTTP service returns 200 and /robots.txt accessible
skill_cards.then_action: Fetch robots.txt, then queue a directory brute force with wordlist to identify hidden endpoints

skill_cards.if_condition: When credentials are captured from enum and privilege escalation candidate located
skill_cards.then_action: Attempt credential reuse across accessible services and flag successful elevations

memory_ops.reason: SSH enumeration strategy reliably produced recon data used in later stages.

next_experiments.title: Automate credential pivoting
